title: Toast z-index hardcodes consent.js's banner value with a one-way, comment-only linkage
evidence:
client/src/components/toast.gleam:34:            "fixed top-20 right-4 z-[2147483001] flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 max-w-sm",
server/priv/static/consent.js:393:    "position:fixed;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:2147483000;" +
grep -n 'toast' server/priv/static/consent.js → no matches (no reciprocal reference on the banner side)
detail: The toast z value is derived from an asset owned by another module (server static JS). Only the toast side is test-pinned; a future banner z-index raise silently re-hides toasts with no CI signal.
recommended_fix: Bind both values in one guard: extend toast_container_position_clears_consent_banner_test to read consent.js and assert its banner z-index stays below the toast pin.

title: New 'Viewing held' term lives in four literals across three modules, including a hand-uppercased twin
evidence:
status_stepper.gleam:109:    "viewed" -> Some("Viewing held")
status_stepper.gleam:175:    Stop(application.Viewed, "viewed", "Viewing held"),
status_pill.gleam:44:        [html.text("Viewing held")],
application_detail.gleam:566:    application.Viewed -> #("bg-navy/10 text-navy", "VIEWING HELD")
detail: A future term rename must find all four sites across three modules; the detail pill's uppercase variant is derived by hand. Spec-sanctioned for this diff (pre-existing inline pattern left as-is).
recommended_fix: Keep this diff as-is per the frozen spec; in a follow-up pass hoist the shared status labels into copy.gleam consts so one rename updates every surface.
